A single layer of transparent cells coated by an extracellular lipid/wax polymer layer called cutin. It prevents desiccation (unregulated water loss) while remaining optically transparent to allow photosynthetic wavelengths to reach the palisade cells beneath.
Adaptation: Desert plants (xerophytes) feature an exceptionally thick waxy cuticle layer.
